acceptance_criteria.text: Trigger "Complete Feature" and confirm → all active feature files move to the archive folder and are absent from their source locations (covers B1)
Trigger any action, let it finish or error out, then immediately trigger another → the second action runs without a "another action is in progress" block (covers B1, B2)
Click "Launch Local Environment" → backend and frontend start and their output appears in the DevHub terminal; no new PowerShell or console window opens (covers B2)
The DevHub shows clearly labelled links or tabs for the DevHub and the app (:3000); clicking either opens or focuses that page without launching a new service (covers B3)

Clicking "Bootstrap DEV" starts the Pi bootstrapper targeting the test environment without any interactive prompt; clicking "Bootstrap PRD" targets production without any interactive prompt (covers B4)
acceptance_criteria.auto: none (SSH to Pi; human verifies in UAT)

acceptance_criteria.text: The launcher can be pinned to the Windows taskbar and launches the DevHub when clicked (covers B1, B5)
